entities.name: Lajos Hernádi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lajos Hernádi was a Hungarian pianist. He played widely across post-war Europe and taught for several decades at the Franz Liszt Academy of Music, where he influenced pianists like Tamás Vásáry, Peter Erős, and György Cziffra.
